patch.value: GH-688: seeded Plan creation must be atomic across ownership boundaries
Make pm plan create with seeded steps and linked artifacts preflight or transact ownership so a failed enrichment cannot leave a partial Plan when author and assignee differ.
A cross-owner seeded plan either persists all requested steps/artifacts or leaves no Plan; CLI and SDK regression tests cover success and rollback.

value.author: codex-root
